highestCommercialGoal: Let a boss turn a verified Radar opportunity into governed intelligence employee work without moving source evidence, deterministic scoring, leads or professional Radar operations into BossAI OS.
largestUserGap: Radar Lite still delegated persistent work through obsolete built-in employee IDs and Workforce Run endpoints, while the planned independent Intelligence Agent did not exist as an installable restart-safe plugin.
userProblem: The boss needs one trusted path from verified market evidence to a reviewable intelligence decision framework, with exact plugin readiness, mandatory approval and durable recovery, while Radar remains the evidence and scoring authority.
userVisibleChange: A real non-Demo opportunity now checks the exact bossai-intelligence-agent installation and creates a BossAI Manager task. The dashboard continues to show safe execution and review states while unsigned, disabled, unhealthy or mismatched plugins fail before task creation.

knownFailures: Collection intent containing the word source was initially misrouted as evidence review
Old Radar delegation selected built-in employee IDs and used obsolete Agent Run and Workforce Run endpoints
An unsigned plugin could otherwise be mistaken for ready employee capacity
AI explanation could be mistaken for a changed Radar score or decision
Demo evidence could be mistaken for real evidence
Holding an Offer open during approval could cause redelivery or dead-lettering
In-memory pending state would be lost after restart
preventionRules: Explicit collection verbs take precedence over generic source wording unless negated
Radar fixes delegation to bossai-intelligence-agent and rejects all other employee IDs
Active source verification rejects Agent Run, Workforce Run and old employee IDs
Exact version, verified signature, enabled status, healthy status and Manager permissions are required
Every result states that Radar scores and decision thresholds remain authoritative
Demo opportunities and Demo evidence remain blocked or labelled
The plugin acknowledges Offers after acceptance and persists pending state through Platform SDK Storage
Restart integration must recover from durable authorization events and plugin-private Storage
